map.交通事故赔偿计算器 使用指南: Traffic Accident Compensation Calculator — User Guide
map.输入伤者年龄、伤残等级、收入与受诉法院所在地标准，依据人身损害赔偿司法解释计算残: Enter the injured person's age, disability grade, income and the standard of the court with jurisdiction, and compute traffic-accident compensation items such as disability compensation and medical costs per the personal injury compensation judicial interpretation, for mediation or litigation reference.
map.残疾赔偿金 = 可支配(或人均纯)收入 × 赔偿年限 × 伤残赔偿系数 × 责任: Disability compensation = disposable (or per-capita net) income × compensation years × disability coefficient × liability share; lost earnings = monthly income ÷ 30 × days off work × liability share
map.残疾赔偿金按受诉法院地上一年度城镇居民人均可支配收入，结合伤残等级赔偿系数与赔偿: Disability compensation uses the previous year's urban per-capita disposable income of the court with jurisdiction, combined with the disability coefficient and compensation years (20 years under 60, one year less per year from 60–74, 5 years above 75) and the liability share; it also includes medical costs, lost earnings (monthly income÷30×days), hospital meal allowances and dependents' living costs, all shared by liability share.
map.交通事故后，按伤残等级、医疗费等估算残疾/死亡赔偿金与总赔偿。: After an accident, estimate disability/death compensation and the total by disability grade and medical costs.
map.交强险限额内不分责任，超出部分按责任比例承担。: Within the compulsory insurance limit liability is not apportioned; the excess is shared by liability share.
map.结合被扶养人生活费、精神抚慰金等综合测算。: Combine dependents' living costs and spiritual consolation payments for a comprehensive estimate.
map.：残疾赔偿金 = 5.2万 × 20 × 0.1 = 104,000 元；医疗费: : disability compensation = 52,000 × 20 × 0.1 = 104,000 CNY; medical costs 30,000 CNY; the compulsory insurance medical limit of 18,000 and the death/disability limit of 180,000 are covered regardless of liability, with the excess at 100% for full liability, totalling about 134,000 CNY plus other items.
map.：上述超出交强险部分按 70% 承担，总赔偿相应降低；工具按责任比例输出对方应赔: : the excess over compulsory insurance is borne at 70%, lowering the total; the tool outputs what the other party should pay by liability share.
map.交强险和三者险怎么赔？: How do compulsory and commercial third-party insurance pay?
map.先由交强险在限额内赔付（不分责），不足部分由商业三者险按责任比例赔，仍不足由侵权: First the compulsory insurance pays within its limit (regardless of liability); any shortfall is covered by commercial third-party insurance by liability share, and the remainder by the tortfeasor.
map.农村户口按什么标准？: What standard applies to rural household registration?
map.人身损害赔偿一般按受诉法院地标准，多地已统一按城镇居民标准计算，具体以受理法院所: Personal injury compensation generally follows the standard of the court with jurisdiction, and many regions now uniformly use the urban resident standard; defer to local statistics of the accepting court.
